response.sql: WITH member_department_pairs AS (SELECT m.member_id, ma.department FROM member m INNER JOIN major ma ON m.link_to_major = ma.major_id), department_stats AS (SELECT department, COUNT(*) as member_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member_department_pairs) as share FROM member_department_pairs GROUP BY department), stats_with_average AS (SELECT *, AVG(share) OVER () as avg_share FROM department_stats) SELECT department, member_count, share, share - avg_share as difference_from_average FROM stats_with_average WHERE share > avg_share ORDER BY share DESC;
